title: Skynet: Workflow-Level Anomaly Detection for Agentic AI via Semantic and Structural Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.06835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic AI systems execute complex tasks through long-horizon workflows of planning, tool use, and multi-agent coordination. Task failures in these systems often originate from a single step, such as an injected prompt or a flawed plan, and are then amplified through downstream dependencies as the corrupted step propagates across many subsequent agents and tool calls. Existing defenses either target a specific class of attacks or failures, or inspect individual prompts and steps in isolation. Both leave the global dependency structure of a workflow unexamined, and miss the inconsistencies that only emerge when the execution is viewed as a whole. We argue that anomaly detection for agentic AI must reason at the workflow level, where global execution structure exposes signals that local checks cannot see. translated_title: Skynet：基于语义与结构建模的智能体AI工作流级异常检测
translated_abstract: 智能体AI系统通过规划、工具使用和多智能体协调等长程工作流来执行复杂任务。这些系统中的任务失败往往源于单个步骤，例如被注入的提示词或有缺陷的计划，随后随着受损步骤在众多后续智能体和工具调用中传播，故障通过下游依赖关系被不断放大。现有的防御方法要么只针对特定类型的攻击或故障，要么孤立地检查单个提示词和步骤。这两种方式都未能考察工作流的全局依赖结构，从而错过了只有在整体审视执行过程时才会显现的不一致性。我们认为，智能体AI的异常检测必须在工作流层面进行推理，因为全局执行结构能够暴露局部检查无法看到的信号。我们提出了Skynet，一个具有坚实原理基础的工作流级异常检测框架，它将观察到的多智能体执行转换为有向工作流……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Skynet框架，通过对多智能体执行进行语义与结构建模，在工作流级别检测异常，从而捕获局部逐步检查无法发现、会沿全局依赖结构传播放大的故障信号。
en_tdlr: Skynet is a principled workflow-level anomaly detection framework that models multi-agent executions semantically and structurally, exposing failure signals rooted in global dependency structures that local per-step checks cannot detect.
